category.name: Social publishing
category.description: Plan, schedule and publish social media content across accounts.
category.audience: Creators, marketers, agencies and communications teams
category.audienceRationale: Publishing spans many sectors but serves a specific marketing/communications function.

pricing.note: Essentials, one channel: $60/year ($5/month equivalent); free SaaS plan separate. Price scales by channel.
Official FAQ says Standard starts at $99, but extracted cards omit numerical price and currency; exact USD annual quote not independently resolved.

oss.name: Postiz
locked: Production in-app design editor requires a separate commercial Polotno SDK license.
oss.classificationReason: AGPL core; vendor claims ungated Cloud parity, but production design editing depends on licensed commercial Polotno software. Tier C for that workflow; scheduling itself remains open.
serviceLimitations: Operate your own infrastructure and register platform developer apps; approvals and analytics scopes required.
AI uses your own provider keys and provider billing.
X analytics availability depends on your X API plan.

health.rsx: Central rsx analyze: balanced policy passed; overall 5.7/10; 39 commits in 30 days.

oss.name: Mixpost Lite
locked: Lite publishing: Facebook Pages, X and Mastodon only; other listed networks require Pro/Enterprise.
Pro adds queue, approval flow, inbox, advanced analytics, AI and API/webhooks.
oss.classificationReason: MIT applies to Lite. Pro/Enterprise are proprietary source-available editions, with everyday workflow gates. First-party Cloud exists but does not make commercial features OSS.
serviceLimitations: Self-hosters supply hosting, maintenance and platform developer-app credentials/approvals.
